material_investigation.scope: Synthetic stops with no contained construction items: first vary building material over natural stone track, then vary underlying constructed-floor material while stop remains granite. Each run covers four materials,16 masks,2 stages (128 cases).
material_investigation.results: Both runs return the same13 stone-art textures, byte-identical to installed source. Building material and underlying construction material do not select wood art in these empty-item fixtures.

material_investigation.remaining: First-item transport and runtime mapping verified; natural gameplay effects remain outside these probes.

selection_icon.implementation: Return fixed native UI texture after building visibility validation, independent of material/terrain/stage.
selection_icon.coverage: Four native clicked material variants match709opaque pixels each. Registered replay checks exact icon RGBA across19terrain/stage states.

contained_item_probe.scope: Paused diagnostic constructs one contained item at a time (oak log, oak block, granite block, iron block, green glass block), traverses16terrain masks and2construction stages. These synthetic items test drawing inputs, not build eligibility.
findings: Completed wood sheet is selected only by a first contained item of native item_type WOOD (log); oak blocks use stone sheet.
Completed artwork recolors the first18 native palette keys from the first contained item actual material solid-state color; first matching duplicate key wins.
Planned artwork always uses the uncolored stone crossing with alpha divided by two, rounded down.
The diagnostic did not advance simulation or save. Final window screenshot is after item cleanup and only establishes capture health; exported RGBA establishes material appearance.
contained_item_probe.runtime_status: Implemented and verified by core tests, synthetic GPU replay, native publication comparison, inspector acceptance and actual-recording GPU replay.

Unknown item restores original uncolored image
contained_item_implementation.limitations: Synthetic construction/item manipulation; natural construction and minecart effects are outside these render/transport probes.
